evidence.claim: Agrati ogni anno trasforma 160.000 tonnellate di acciaio in 8 miliardi di componenti per OEM e fornitori Tier 1, con centri logistici a Trezzo d'Adda e Verona.
evidence.quote: Each year, we turn 160.000 tons of steel into 8 billion components , enabling the assembly of over 40 million vehicles — driven by 8% investment in innovation. || Agrati expanded its logistics network with new centres in Trezzo d’Adda (2009) and Verona (2015) || a strong sales team supporting major OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers
